verses.1: And Daryos received the throne after two generations.
verses.2: He ruled over the kingdom of Ahshadrafnyaya for a hundred and twelve years.
verses.3: And from above, they arrange the three levels of Daniyel. From below, they arrange those of Lehavan Ahshdarpnaya. Two of them are used for their purpose, while the other one is not used at all.
verses.4: Eadien Daniel Danah Hawa was defeated by Sarkhay and Ahshdarpnaya. All those who accepted his spirit became his slaves. And the king made him the ruler over all kingdoms.
verses.5: Edin Sarkaya and Ahshdarpnaya are in a state of forgetting, because they have forgotten about Daniel from the side of royalty. They also forgot about everything else. They cannot forget anything that has happened in the past. Everything that happened in the past is still remembered by them.
verses.6: Adiyan Gubraya, let us go. We must not forget Daniyel Danah. All those who have forgotten him should be punished by God’s judgment.
verses.7: Aden Sarkaya and Ahashdarpnaya were also angry with the king. They said to him, “King, you should live forever.”
verses.8: All the officials of the kingdom of Sargonya and Ahshdarpnaya were scattered. They were forced to live in exile for a long time. No one could do anything against them. People also suffered greatly because of this. Until now, they still suffer under the rule of your king.
verses.9: Just as a king builds a palace, so too should Esarra establish laws and regulations. They should be set down in writing, so that they cannot be changed later on. This is in accordance with the law of Madai.
verses.10: Everyone who accepts the king’s commands must obey them as written.
verses.11: And Daniel knew that it was written about her in the Book of Chronicles. Her tomb was located facing Jerusalem. And at that time, she was blessed by God. She was protected and honored above all others who received gifts from the king.
verses.12: Eadain Gubraya, let them feel sorrow and forget about Daniel in the wilderness. I pray to the Lord first.
verses.13: They came forward and said, “We demand that the king be punished for his actions. He has committed a crime against all people. People will stand up against him from now on. The king must be punished accordingly.” They asked, “How should he be punished?”
verses.14: They replied, “We do not accept your king. He is none of our people from among the Jews. Do not place him on your throne. He is a man who has violated laws and regulations. It is time for him to be removed from power.”
verses.15: Eadainn was king, just as it is written. He heard the sound of flames rising above him, and above Daniel, there was chaos and destruction. Even above the sky, there was nothing but darkness.
verses.16: Let them go, for they are suffering under the king’s rule. Let them say to the king, “Know that the king is a man of religion; he will bring about liberation from all laws and regulations.” He will establish justice in place of injustice.
verses.17: Bedain Malcha said, “And it shall be for Daniel. And let him go with the lion.” Malcha replied to Daniel, “O God, you are the one who will always protect him.”
verses.18: And it was a beautiful stone, with a smooth surface. It was sealed by the king’s seal, with great care. And it remained unchanged in the temple.
verses.19: Eadainn Azal Malkha, to have her own kingdom. And in the land of Tuvah, and with a heart that is not subject to anyone else’s control. She changed her fate for herself.
verses.20: In Bedia, the king will rise up in Shpafparra. He will be raised in Naghaa, and in Hithbhalah, for the sake of Ariyavata.
verses.21: And as she approached Giv’a, Daniel cried out in pain. He said to Daniel, “Daniel, you are a servant of God. You must often pray to Him for help from the lion.”
verses.22: Edayin Daniel with the king, the king for all time.
verses.23: O God, send your warriors to destroy her! Do not pity me. Those who accepted her before me have already been punished. Even those who were before you did not serve me.
verses.24: Bedarin Malkha Shagia Tav Alehi, and Ladaniel said to Hensaka from Gubba. And Daniel was taken away from Gubba. And all the soldiers were not left behind there.
verses.25: And the king said, “Let us go and eat some of their meat. Let us also take their women with us. Do not delay any longer until we rule over them as kings. And all their possessions shall be ours.”
verses.26: May the king of Edin Darayos write for all nations and tribes, so that peace may be established everywhere.
verses.27: From the beginning, it has always been so that in all my kingdoms, there will be those who rule and those who are ruled over. From ancient times, this is how it has always been. He is the God of life and existence, forever. His kingdom will never end.
verses.28: May they be destroyed and defeated. May they serve those who are weak and powerless. May they be destroyed by the hands of the lion.
verses.29: And Daniel ruled over the kingdom of Darius, as well as over the kingdom of Khoresh Parsa.
